import bpy,json,numpy as np,struct,zlib
from pathlib import Path
ns=bpy.app.driver_namespace['work15'];root=ns['root'];cap=ns['cap'];craft=ns['craft']
assert not craft.get('work15_cap_tone')
m=bpy.data.materials['W15_WeatheredCapPaint'];p=m.node_tree.nodes.get('Principled BSDF');node=p.inputs['Base Color'].links[0].from_node
im=bpy.data.images.load(bpy.path.abspath(node.image.filepath),check_existing=False);im.colorspace_settings.name='Non-Color';im.reload()
a=np.empty(len(im.pixels),np.float32);im.pixels.foreach_get(a);a=a.reshape(im.size[1],im.size[0],4);bpy.data.images.remove(im)
a[:,:,:3]*=np.array([.66,.76,.86]);a=np.round(np.clip(a,0,1)*255).astype(np.uint8)[::-1]
h,w=a.shape[:2]
def chunk(k,d):return struct.pack('>I',len(d))+k+d+struct.pack('>I',zlib.crc32(k+d)&0xffffffff)
path=root/'assets/coast/textures/W15_CapPaint_albedo.png';assert not path.exists()
path.write_bytes(b'\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n'+chunk(b'IHDR',struct.pack('>IIBBBBB',w,h,8,6,0,0,0))+chunk(b'IDAT',zlib.compress(b''.join(b'\x00'+row.tobytes() for row in a),6))+chunk(b'IEND',b''))
im=bpy.data.images.load(str(path),check_existing=False);im.colorspace_settings.name='sRGB';im.pack();node.image=im
craft['work15_cap_tone']=True
p=cap/'cap_response.json';d=json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf8'));d['cap_color_srgb_multiplier']=[.66,.76,.86];d['main_roof_albedo_unchanged']=True;p.write_text(json.dumps(d,indent=2),encoding='utf8')
bpy.ops.wm.save_as_mainfile(filepath=bpy.data.filepath)
print('W15 cap blue-grey paint retained under broad side lighting.')
